scientific_question: On the same frozen Kimi K3 resource inventories and physically grounded service model repaired in Experiment 022, can selective duplicate residency of stateless WHOLE_EXPERT:p8 expert groups, combined with non-clairvoyant queue-aware runtime routing, improve latency-constrained steady-state serving throughput per abstract cost unit by at least 20% relative to the strongest unique-residency baseline?
hypothesis_plain_language: Extra heterogeneous resources should create alternative execution paths rather than additional mandatory dependencies.
frozen_preregistration_hypothesis: A heterogeneous resource pool is more useful when excess memory creates alternative execution paths than when every additional worker creates another mandatory dependency.
repair_scope: Repair only the invalid planner objective, FLEX_POOL feasible-set search, correctness execution, analysis publication, and finalization path. No scientific input, threshold, baseline construction, routing policy, shared-NIC model, inference technique, or physical method changes.

canonical_primary_slo_scorer: Use one public score_plan_under_primary_slo implementation for planner acceptance, branch and envelope selection, saturation summaries, headline analysis, and negative-control analysis.
Evaluate SHARED_NIC at exactly concurrency 1, 8, 32, 64, and 128; require every ServingRun PASS.
Set the latency budget to 2.0 times U_STRONG C1 p95; retain p95-eligible runs; maximize target rows per second; when points are within 0.5 percent of the maximum choose the smallest concurrency.
Compute abstract node cost with the existing function and efficiency as target rows per second divided by abstract cost.
action_acceptance: C32 remains a frozen search heuristic and diagnostic only.
FLEX_FREE maximizes primary-SLO raw throughput; FLEX_POOL maximizes primary-SLO throughput per abstract cost.

Require at least 0.5 percent true SLO objective gain, candidate SLO throughput at least 99 percent of current SLO throughput, and candidate SLO throughput at least 99 percent of original U_STRONG SLO throughput.
Reject candidates with no primary-SLO-eligible concurrency using NO_PRIMARY_SLO_ELIGIBLE_CONCURRENCY.
Choose qualifying actions deterministically by SLO objective gain, added replica bytes, newly activated nodes, layer ID, replica count, primary tuple, then alternate map.
primary_candidate_generation: FLEX_FREE retains at most two completion-ranked P8 primary groups restricted to U_STRONG used nodes.
FLEX_POOL forms the raw feasible group set, then retains the FASTEST group and the LOWEST_RESULTING_COST group, deduplicated, preserving the frozen maximum of two.
alternate_candidate_generation: FLEX_FREE retains its deterministic greedy assignment within the already-active node set.
FLEX_POOL evaluates at most two unique maps per primary layout and replica count: NO_NEW_NODE and UNRESTRICTED_FASTEST, using the frozen deterministic group-cost tie-breaks.
flex_pool_superset: Run POOL-U from U_STRONG and POOL-FREE from the final FLEX_FREE plan with the node restriction removed; inherited FLEX_FREE actions are not counted as new FLEX_POOL actions.
Select the final FLEX_POOL envelope from exactly U_STRONG clone, FLEX_FREE clone, POOL-U, and POOL-FREE after the cumulative 99 percent U_STRONG throughput guard.
Choose maximum primary-SLO efficiency, then higher throughput, lower cost, fewer replicas, fewer used nodes, and canonical plan SHA-256.
Audit all 27 inventories at 1e-12 relative numerical tolerance and require FLEX_FREE to be present in every final pool envelope.
repair_algorithm.ablations: Derive FLEX_FREE_NO_ALT and FLEX_POOL_NO_ALT only by removing alternate residency from their repaired parent plans; preserve P8 and all base placement details.
repair_algorithm.correctness: Wrap Experiment 022 production-native 93-layer manifest correctness with replica-aware physical-destination dispatch. For groups with alternates force the alternate when (layer_id + logical_group_id + chunk_index) modulo 2 equals 1, without changing logical ownership, routes, weights, reduction slots, or canonical group order.
repair_algorithm.unchanged_runtime: Do not change select_fork_join_routes, SHARED_NIC semantics, E022 services, workload, warm-up, quantiles, K3 semantics, or the admitted P8 partition degree.
repair_algorithm.generalized_finalization: Finalize an explicitly supplied authoritative and reproducibility attempt, collect every validity failure, and call the unchanged E023 verdict tree without expected-outcome special cases.

immutable_scientific_inputs: the 27 inventories and their 18 headline, 3 control, and 6 capacity cohort membership
stop_conditions: any repaired U_STRONG canonical plan hash differs from deterministic-run-1
any control violates the frozen minus-5-percent efficiency or raw-throughput guard
deterministic-run-2 and deterministic-run-3 fail the frozen reproducibility comparison
any other mandatory validity gate fails
